```yaml
name: Cleanup Neon preview branch

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      NEON_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.NEON_API_KEY }}
      NEON_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.NEON_PROJECT_ID }}
      PR_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Neon CLI
        run: npm install -g @neondatabase/cli

      - name: Delete Neon preview branch
        run: |
          echo "Attempting to delete Neon branch: $PR_BRANCH"
          neonctl delete branch "$PR_BRANCH" --project-id "$NEON_PROJECT_ID" --yes || true
```
